title: Connecting halves
content: Start off by connecting keyboard halves using TRRS cable. Make sure it is fully inserted into the port. Last milimeter often requires some force.

title: Connecting to PC
content: Connect the keyboard to your PC using USB-C cable. The keyboard should be recognized as a standard HID device. Treat left half as primary device.

title: Warning!
content: Never disconnect or connect TRRS cable while the keyboard is powered on. It may damage the keyboard. Always disconnect keyboard from PC before doing that.

title: Keymap editor.
content: Once the keyboard is connected you can edit your keymap by visiting https://vial.rocks/. Here you make changes on the fly without needing to flash firmware.

title: Finished!
content: You should be ready to type!
